title: Establish a Programme and Project Management Capability in the Architecture
narrative: FEDC is entering a period of significant capital investment — the network reinforcement programme, the smart metering rollout, and the operational technology refresh collectively represent over £180M of committed expenditure over the next five years. Programme and project management at FEDC is currently handled through a combination of spreadsheets, email, and a standalone project tracking tool that is not integrated with financial systems, resource planning, or the asset register. This creates coordination risk at the programme level and prevents effective portfolio-level resource and budget management. We propose adding programme and project management as an explicit capability in the architecture. A dedicated application supporting end-to-end programme governance — from business case through delivery to benefits realisation — will be selected and integrated with the ERP, resource management, and asset management systems.

requirements.title: End-to-end programme governance
requirements.description: The solution must support the full programme lifecycle: business case approval, project initiation, delivery tracking, stage gate governance, and benefits realisation tracking.

requirements.title: ERP integration
requirements.description: The solution must integrate bidirectionally with the existing ERP system for financial commitment tracking, actual cost reporting, and purchase order management.

requirements.title: Portfolio-level reporting
requirements.description: The solution must provide portfolio-level dashboards showing cross-programme resource utilisation, budget vs actual, and milestone status without manual data consolidation.
